title: Moose's Flowering Vines
description: This small addon pack for the MooseCraft family of resource packs adds small, colorful flowers to vines in your minecraft world.
body:
## How do you get more whimsical than blocks made by a Moose?
Well, you have that Moose give vines flowers! This small addon pack for the MooseCraft family of resource packs, adds subtle 3d flowers to vines in four color combinations: yellow and white, cyan and orange, red and purple, and blue and magenta. This small change adds a splash of color to jungles, swamps and more!

This pack can also be used as a standalone pack and is compatible with other packs as long as this pack is placed above any packs that modify vines.

### Check out the rest of the MooseCraft family of resource packs, including:
- [MooseCraft](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moose-craft): Combines all of the packs (excluding this pack and flowering vines)
- [Moose Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moose-items): Adds 3d item models to almost every item in the game!
- [Moose UI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mooseui): Overhaul to Minecraft's UI with support for OptiGUI!
- [Moose Mobs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moosemobs): Updating many of Minecraft's Mobs to the MooseCraft art style!
- [Moose's Varied Wildflowers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mooses-varied-wildflowers): standalone addon for adding 3 new color variants to wildflowers.
